title: Duplicate carriage: Positive-ink invoice
topics: Two pointers, windows and prefix sums
summary: The readings are sorted ascending. Compact adjacent equal values into one value, preserving sorted order. Return the sum of strictly positive values in the derived sequence, or 0 when none exist.
descriptionMd:
Repeated catalog numbers occupy neighboring slots on an already sorted carriage. Mina prepares an invoice that accepts only positive ink adjustments. Zero and negative derived readings stay off the invoice.

The readings are sorted ascending. Compact adjacent equal values into one value, preserving sorted order.

Return the sum of strictly positive values in the derived sequence, or 0 when none exist.

Implement duplicateCarriagePositiveInkInvoice(readings, k). k is part of the common inspection-card signature and does not affect this task's result.
unitIntro: Read and write pointers. The readings are sorted ascending. Compact adjacent equal values into one value, preserving sorted order. Keep the sequence order specified here before computing the requested receipt. A scan invariant says what has been processed and what remains. Work through the proof strip first, then change the returned summary without changing the definition of that sequence. The last card revisits loop accumulators from Hello, Keys.
constraints: 1 <= k <= 8. All arithmetic results fit a signed 32-bit integer.
Numeric readings lie between -1,000,000 and 1,000,000, subject to the task's shape and ordering rules.

Target time O(n); auxiliary space including the derived sequence O(n). n is the input length; d distinct values; q query count; M maximum reading; V vertices; E edges; h tree height; r reported tree nodes.
hints: Start with read and write pointers. What state describes the portion you have already processed?

Return the sum of strictly positive values in the derived sequence, or 0 when none exist. Handle the empty derived sequence according to the stated return rule.

cases.explanation: The derived sequence is [-3,0,7,12]. Return the sum of strictly positive values in the derived sequence, or 0 when none exist. This gives 19.
The derived sequence is [-2,4]. Return the sum of strictly positive values in the derived sequence, or 0 when none exist. This gives 4.
The derived sequence is []. Return the sum of strictly positive values in the derived sequence, or 0 when none exist. This gives 0.
